It provides “Print Creator” for form printing, “Form Bridge” for creating Web forms, “kViewer” for external publication of data, “kMailer” for sending emails, “kBackup” for data backup, and “Data Collect” for data collection and calculation. entries.a45a062f0abb15a0: Under its mission of 'freeing everyone from inefficient work' and its corporate philosophy, the company aims to achieve 'the popularization of IT.' As a stock-type business in which fees accrue according to the period of use, the company treats paid contracts, MRR and churn rate as its key indicators, and will pursue expansion of MRR through an increase in paid contracts and a reduction in churn rate. For the safety confirmation service, the company is promoting use across the entire supply chain; for the kintone-linked services, it is working to raise revenue per customer and respond to enterprise use; and for NotePM, it is working to expand brand awareness and sales channels. As issues to address, it also lists the creation of new businesses and M&A.

entries.e865def3af5c075b: Safety confirmation service (a cloud service for confirming the safety of employees and sharing information during disasters)
entries.f54103ec932e72b2: This is a cloud service for confirming the safety of employees and others during disasters via mobile phones, smartphones and personal computers. It has functions for safety confirmation by simultaneous transmission, aggregation of contact status, and discussion, posting and communication of countermeasures, and can also be used for information sharing and emergency contact during emergencies such as pandemics. Servers automatically expand in linkage with earthquake alerts issued by the Japan Meteorological Agency and others, to cope with sudden surges in access during disasters. The number of paid contracts was 4,753 as of the end of December 2025. Amounts for each service are not disclosed.
